story_facts.fact: The venue is an open-air rooftop lounge with fire pits, reclaimed wood and a skylight.
The space has two full bars and accommodates 400 reception guests or 100 seated guests for private events.
Its weekly public service is nightclub hours Friday through Sunday. The official calendar separates Saturday rooftop nights, Sunday DESEO events and selected Friday MIX 360 nights.
